payload.title: File:Alxasaurus Scale.svg
payload.usage_terms: Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication
payload.description_html:
Size comparison of the Lower Cretaceous Chinese therizinosauroid maniraptoran Alxasaurus elesitaiensis. The silhouette is scaled to a 37.5 cm (14.8 in) humerus. The human silhouette is from File:Silhouette of man standing and facing forward.svg (CC0).

References

  • Alxasaurus skeletal reconstruction by Jaime Headden
  • Li, Daqing; Peng, Cuo; You, Hailu; Lamanna, Matthew C.; Harris, Jerald D.; Lacovara, Kenneth J.; Zhang, Jianping (2007). "A Large Therizinosauroid (Dinosauria: Theropoda) from the Early Cretaceous of Northwestern China". Acta Geologica Sinica 81 (4): 539−549.
